Append:
# Weekly parent email (optional). Without a key, Settings shows a preview and nothing is sent.
# RESEND_API_KEY=
# On Vercel, a Resend key only sends when this is also set (keeps old keys inert):
# KAIZEN_EMAIL=resend
# Origin for links in emails. Required off Vercel (a request's Host header isn't trusted); on Vercel it defaults to the deployment's address:
# APP_URL=https://kaizenedu.net
# Sender on a domain verified in Resend:
# EMAIL_FROM="KaizenEDU <weekly@kaizenedu.net>"
# Optional key for confirmation codes and send tokens (defaults to one derived from the Resend key). Change it to end every token at once:
# EMAIL_SECRET=
